name: Abruzzo, Italy

visa.notes: Elective residence visa requires ~€31K/year income. Must demonstrate passive income and health insurance.

rent.notes: Immobiliare.it October 2026: Abruzzo asking rents average 8.35 EUR/m2/mo (Pescara 9.83, L'Aquila 8.31, Teramo 7.95, Chieti 7.09), so a 90-110 m2 2-3BR runs ~700-1000 on the coast and ~650-800 inland; Numbeo Pescara 3BR 803 outside centre, 1066 centre (June 2026). Pet-friendly leases are common but landlords may ask a higher deposit.

sources.title: Immobiliare.it - Mercato immobiliare Abruzzo
Expatica - Cost of living in Pescara

utilities.notes: Facile.it Osservatorio (Oct 2026) Pescara households average 937 EUR/yr electricity (1584 kWh) and 922 EUR/yr gas (1015 Smc) = ~155/mo at modest consumption; a 2-3BR house with winter heating plus water (~25/mo) and TARI (~25/mo) lands near 230. Numbeo Pescara basic utilities 85 m2 = 226 EUR. Excludes internet.

Facile.it - Osservatorio luce e gas Abruzzo

healthcare.notes: Non-EU elective-residence retirees register with the SSN voluntarily: 7.5% of worldwide income up to 20,658 EUR plus 4% up to 51,646 EUR, floor 2,000 EUR and cap ~2,789 EUR/yr, valid for the whole nucleo familiare (~167-232/mo for the couple). Typical adds a modest Italian private top-up (Italian resident policies 800-2,000 EUR/yr); max assumes two private policies on top of the capped SSN fee.

insurance.notes: Re-modelled from the old template (110 was health cover, now in healthcare). Renters contents + RC capofamiglia policies (e.g. Redion, Bene, Chubb) sit in the 150-200 EUR/yr band Facile.it reports for Oct 2026, i.e. ~15/mo; dog liability usually rides on the RC capofamiglia cover.

petCare.notes: Money.it (July 2026): annual vet visits 60-100 EUR, booster vaccines 40-60 EUR each, antiparassitari 10-20 EUR/mo, diagnostics 200-300 EUR/yr; large-breed total care is the top of the range. ~70/mo without pet insurance.

sources.title: Money.it - Quanto costa mantenere un cane (luglio 2026)

petDaycare.notes: Pensione per cani in Abruzzo 20-26 EUR/day for a large dog (Cronoshare Roseto degli Abruzzi), 20-40 EUR/day nationally; ~6 boarding/daycare days a month = ~150.

sources.title: Cronoshare - Pensione per cani Roseto degli Abruzzi
Money.it - Quanto costa mantenere un cane (luglio 2026)

petGrooming.notes: Toelettatura 20-80 EUR per session, long-coated and large breeds at the top; a Bernese full groom every 6-8 weeks (~70-80) averages ~50/mo.

sources.title: Money.it - Quanto costa mantenere un cane (luglio 2026)

transportation.notes: Abruzzo outside Pescara needs a car. Isfort 2026: Italian households average 334 EUR/mo on the car; Facile.it 2026 components: petrol ~2 EUR/L (Numbeo Pescara 1.85), maintenance ~662 EUR/yr for a petrol car at 10k km, bollo 150-280 EUR, RC auto well below the 2,060 EUR new-driver average for 60-year-olds with a good class. Low-mileage retiree couple with one used car ~240/mo; Pescara bus pass ~42.

entertainment.notes: Iliad FTTH fibre 22.99 EUR/mo fixed (with an Iliad mobile line; Numbeo Pescara broadband 33); streaming ~35; mid-range dinner for 2 ~63 EUR three times a month = ~190; cinema 8.40 and activities ~40.

healthcare.system: Italian SSN (Servizio Sanitario Nazionale). Regional hospital in Pescara. Quality varies but adequate for most needs.
healthcare.waitTimes: Public: 4-12 weeks for specialists. Private affordable alternative.
healthcare.prescriptionCoverage: SSN covers essential prescriptions with tiered co-pays (ticket)
